rows.definition: internal/agent/anthropic_cachebp.go is the OFFENSIVE half of the kernel's cache-prefix control: it PLACES a cache_control breakpoint on the stable system+tools head of an outbound Anthropic request when the caller left none, and upgrades an existing one to the 1h TTL tier, so a raw/minimal caller still gets provider prompt-cache reuse. It houses PlaceAnthropicCacheBreakpoint(WithOutcome) and UpgradeAnthropicStableCacheTTL1h.
rows.distinction: It is the PLACEMENT module that writes a breakpoint that does not exist yet, not the defensive anthropic_compact.go half that only ANCHORS on and never busts an existing breakpoint, and not PlaceAnthropicCacheBreakpointWithOutcome, the one observable function within it.

rows.definition: agent.PlaceAnthropicCacheBreakpointWithOutcome performs the identical byte-splice as PlaceAnthropicCacheBreakpoint but additionally returns a BreakpointOutcome (Reason, Target, Rewritten, MovedVolatile, PredictedUplift) reporting where the breakpoint landed or why it bailed (already_set, no_stable_head, volatile_head, splice_failed, redecode_failed).
rows.distinction: It is the OBSERVABLE variant that reports an outcome, not PlaceAnthropicCacheBreakpoint (the breakpoint placer) which discards that detail, and not UpgradeAnthropicStableCacheTTL1h which upgrades an EXISTING breakpoint's TTL rather than placing a new one.

rows.definition: CacheableTokens (cacheobs.Observed.CacheableTokens and cachemeta.PrefixResult.CacheableTokens) is the lookup-side half of the #3390 split: prompt tokens that MATCHED a stable prefix and were therefore eligible to be served from cache, regardless of whether the lookup actually served them. CacheabilityRatio = CacheableTokens / prompt tokens.
rows.distinction: It is the COULD-BE-SERVED eligibility count, not ReusedTokens (the tokens actually served from cache) and not CachedInputTokens (the provider's realized hit count on the wire).

rows.definition: guardvars.CacheAttributionVars is the concrete /debug/vars JSON struct type - shared by internal/guardvars, the gateway producer cacheAttributionVars, and cmd/fak/info's guardInfoCacheAttribution alias - that surfaces the provider-vs-fak owner split for cache-like savings, so an operator dashboard and the guard's own info renderer read the identical field-for-field shape.
rows.distinction: It is the concrete /debug/vars STRUCT TYPE for the owner/plane split, not the general cache-attribution labeling concept it implements, and not ManagedCacheVars, the sibling struct for the managed-cache TTL-upgrade posture block.

rows.definition: agent.CacheBurstBreakEvenTurns prices an explicit cache-burst rewrite: given dropped cached tokens, invalidated suffix tokens, and the provider's read/write price multipliers, it returns the minimum future turns needed for the per-turn read saving to repay the one-time cold-rewrite penalty (0 = no penalty; MaxInt = never breaks even).
rows.distinction: It is the PRICING function computing the break-even turn count, not CacheBurstPaysBack (the boolean gate that compares this value against the turns actually remaining in the session).

rows.definition: agent.CompactReasonCachedSpan ("cached_span") is the identical closed-vocabulary CompactOutcome.Reason value reused verbatim across all three compaction call sites - the plain compactor (anthropic_compact.go), the goal-pinned compactor (anthropic_compact_goalpin.go), and the view-level compactor (anthropic_compact_view.go) - so every layer refuses to drop a cache_control-marked span under the same observable reason string.
rows.distinction: It is the shared REASON VALUE consumed identically by three compaction entry points, not the CompactOutcome struct that carries it, and not CacheBurstPaysBack, the separate economic gate that can deliberately override this same protection when the future savings repay the one-time cost.

rows.definition: agent.defaultCacheReadMult (0.1) is the compaction fire-gate's local mirror of the provider cache-read price multiplier, used to price a shed span's opportunity cost when a Compact*.ReadMult field is unset (<=0). cacheprice_pin_test.go asserts it stays numerically pinned to the canonical internal/cacheprice.ReadMultiplier so the two constants cannot drift.
rows.distinction: It is the AGENT-LOCAL pinned mirror consumed by the fire-gate math, not internal/cacheprice (the single canonical source every consumer pins to) and not CacheReadMultiplier (the gateway's own price-coefficient copy).

rows.definition: gateway.DefaultVCacheAnchor is the const (true) pinning the M2 star-anchor pre-flight gate's default posture to ON, so every entrypoint that declares the --vcache-anchor flag (guard.go, serve.go) shares one edit point instead of hard-coding true at each call site (#1493).
rows.distinction: It is the DEFAULT-VALUE constant a flag is seeded with, not VCacheAnchor (the parsed flag/config field carrying the CURRENT resolved posture), and not vcachestar, the separate `fak vcache star` CLI surface for computing M2 star anchors offline.

rows.definition: frontierswe.FoldCacheWitness([]CacheSample) CacheWitnessSeries folds an ordered slice of periodic /metrics scrapes into the CacheWitnessSeries trajectory: it derives per-interval CacheWitnessPoints from consecutive CacheSamples and stamps the result with CacheWitnessSchema.
rows.distinction: It is the FOLD FUNCTION - samples in, series out - not CacheSample (one raw scrape it consumes) and not CacheWitnessSeries (the struct it produces).

rows.definition: cmd/fak's guardCachePostureArgs(mode, apiKeyEnv) shapes the `fak guard ...` CLI flags a launcher (accounts_launch.go, dispatch_canary.go) splices in for a resolved managed-cache posture mode; fleetGuardCachePostureArgs() wraps it to resolve the mode from the fleet env knobs first.
rows.distinction: It is the FLAG-SHAPING function producing argv strings, not guardManagedCachePosture (the resolved decision struct it is built from) and not the managed-cache posture flag itself (the raw auto|on|off operator input).

rows.definition: cmd/fak's guardManagedCacheOn = "on" is one of the three closed managed-cache posture mode string literals (alongside auto/off) that guardCachePostureArgs and the guard's mode resolver switch on to force the stable-prefix 1h-TTL cache upgrade unconditionally.
rows.distinction: It is the "on" LITERAL VALUE of the posture mode, not guardManagedCachePosture (the resolved struct carrying active/reason) and not the managed-cache posture flag as a whole (the entire auto|on|off input surface).

rows.definition: guardvars.ManagedCacheVars is the concrete /debug/vars JSON struct type - built by the gateway's managedCacheVars and mirrored by cmd/fak/info's guardInfoManagedCache alias - surfacing the managed-cache 1h TTL-upgrade POSTURE and its outcome for a session.
rows.distinction: It is the concrete /debug/vars STRUCT TYPE for the managed-cache block, not CacheAttributionVars (the sibling owner/plane block) and not guardManagedCachePosture (the CLI-side resolved decision struct in a different package).

rows.definition: agent.messageHasCacheControl(el) reports whether a message's TOP-LEVEL content field carries a cache_control breakpoint, by decoding el.Content and delegating to rawHasCacheControl.
rows.distinction: It is the SHALLOW, one-level detector the compaction guards use, not messageHasCacheControlForElide (the deep, any-depth variant the elision shrinker needs because it can reach nested tool_result content) and not rawHasCacheControl itself (the raw-bytes predicate it wraps).

rows.definition: gatewayMetrics.observeVCacheGovernorDecision(family, tsUnixMillis, turns) is the step in the logInferenceTurn -> observeVCacheTurn -> observeVCacheGovernorDecision -> journal pipeline that classifies one family's retained turns window into a vcacheGovernorDecisionRecord and appends it to the governor's decision journal.
rows.distinction: It is the CLASSIFYING step that turns an observed turns window into one journal record, not vcacheGovernorDecisionRecord (the record type it produces) and not vcacheFamiliesVars (the separate /debug/vars renderer for the live per-family window).

rows.definition: livecodebench.RunRawArmCached(ctx, cfg, release, problems, sample, cache, prior) layers #2108's cache-reuse and --continue-existing resume semantics around RunRawArm without changing it: with cache==nil and prior==nil it behaves exactly like RunRawArm.
rows.distinction: It is the CACHE-AWARE wrapper composing reuse/resume around the raw LCB arm runner, not UseCache (the CLI flag on cmd/livecodebench that decides whether to invoke this reuse path at all).

rows.definition: cmd/livecodebench's --use-cache flag (parsed into useCache / RunConfig.UseCache) tells the raw-arm runner to reuse previously generated completions from --cache-dir instead of regenerating them, mirroring lcb_runner's --use_cache (cache key = model+prompt+n+temperature+release).
rows.distinction: It is a BENCHMARK-HARNESS reuse toggle scoped to livecodebench sample generation, wholly unrelated to fak's runtime KV/provider prompt cache - it caches LLM completions on disk, not inference-time tokens.

rows.definition: gateway.Config.VCacheAnchor - wired from the --vcache-anchor CLI flag / *vcacheAnchor in guard.go and serve.go - is the resolved posture of the M2 star-anchor pre-flight gate for a running gateway session; it seeds from DefaultVCacheAnchor (true) unless overridden.
rows.distinction: It is the RESOLVED flag/config field carrying the CURRENT posture, not DefaultVCacheAnchor (the constant it defaults from) and not vcachestar, the separate `fak vcache star` CLI surface for computing M2 star anchors offline.

rows.definition: gateway's VCacheFamilies field - rendered by vcacheFamiliesVars from the retained vcacheobserve.Turn window - is the /debug/vars `vcache_families` block reporting the live per-family provider-cache observation state, reconciled against the same window the governor journal observes.
rows.distinction: It is the /debug/vars RENDERING of the live per-family window, not vcacheGovernorDecisionRecord(s) (the journaled classification history derived from the same window) and not vCache (the generic control-plane concept).

rows.definition: gateway's vcacheGovernorDecisionRecord is the struct type for ONE entry the vcacheGovernorDecisionJournal retains, produced by observeVCacheGovernorDecision and hashed by hashVCacheGovernorDecision for tamper-evident chaining.
rows.distinction: It is the single-entry RECORD TYPE, not vcacheGovernorDecisionRecords (the accessor returning the full retained slice) and not observeVCacheGovernorDecision (the classifier that produces one).

rows.definition: gatewayMetrics.vcacheGovernorDecisionRecords() returns the full retained slice of vcacheGovernorDecisionRecord entries from the governor's journal (via recordsCopy), the read accessor consumers use to inspect decision history.
rows.distinction: It is the ACCESSOR METHOD returning the whole slice, not vcacheGovernorDecisionRecord (the single-entry type it returns many of).

rows.definition: CachePosture is the observed per-session cache warmth label ("warm"/"cold"/"managed"/"unknown") surfaced by cmd/fak/session_inventory.go's sessionCachePosture (projected from idle-seconds-since-last-stamp) and mirrored as internal/sidecar's Posture.CachePosture field in the sidecar status report.
rows.distinction: It is the OBSERVED per-session state label, not the managed-cache posture flag (the operator's auto|on|off INPUT knob) and not guardManagedCachePosture (the guard's own resolved active/reason decision struct).

rows.definition: toon.DecideInput.CacheResident (set via the gateway's toonCacheResident) reports whether an MCP tool-result span already sits inside a cached prefix, one of the TOON wire's shaping inputs alongside Volatile and OutputDirection.
rows.distinction: It is a per-span BOOLEAN SIGNAL feeding the TOON wire-shaping decision, not CacheHit (the vdso event marking an actual cache hit) and not the KV cache the span is resident IN.

rows.definition: frontierswe.CacheSample is one periodic /metrics scrape's CUMULATIVE cache counters during a frontierswe run - the raw input FoldCacheWitness consumes to derive per-interval CacheWitnessPoints.
rows.distinction: It is the RAW, cumulative per-scrape sample, not CacheWitnessPoint (the folded, per-interval DELTA point derived from consecutive samples) and not CacheWitnessSeries (the whole folded trajectory).

rows.definition: frontierswe.CacheWitnessPoint is one folded point of a CacheWitnessSeries.Points series: the per-interval delta derived from two consecutive CacheSamples, threaded through cmd/fak/frontierswe_cachewitness.go and stamped into run.go's report.
rows.distinction: It is the folded per-interval POINT, not CacheSample (the raw cumulative scrape it is derived FROM) and not CacheWitnessSeries (the containing series struct it is an element OF).

rows.definition: frontierswe.CacheWitnessSchema is the versioned schema-id string constant FoldCacheWitness stamps onto every folded CacheWitnessSeries, so a downstream reader can detect a schema change before parsing the trace.
rows.distinction: It is the VERSION-ID STRING CONSTANT stamped onto the series, not CacheWitnessSeries (the struct it is stamped into) and not cachewitness, the general provenance-fold concept the series belongs to.

rows.definition: frontierswe.CacheWitnessSeries is the folded trajectory FoldCacheWitness produces: a Schema id, the per-interval Points ([]CacheWitnessPoint), and the realized cache-reuse rate for a frontierswe run, threaded through run.go's report.
rows.distinction: It is the WHOLE folded trajectory struct, not CacheWitnessPoint (one element inside its Points slice) and not CacheSample (the raw per-scrape input it was folded FROM).
